visual_action: The video shows a ceremony on the floor of the U.S. House of Representatives. Speaker Mike Johnson, at the podium, calls for Adelita Grijalva to be sworn in. The video cuts to a split screen showing both Johnson and Grijalva raising their right hands as he administers the oath of office. After she takes the oath, the chamber breaks into a standing ovation. Grijalva smiles and shakes hands with other members of Congress.

cast.name: Adelita Grijalva
cast.evidence: Her name is in the on-screen text, 'WATCH: Adelita Grijalva has been sworn in to Congress', and she is shown being sworn in.

cast.name: Mike Johnson
cast.evidence: He is shown on screen administering the oath of office and is identified by a chyron as 'Honorable Mike Johnson Speaker of the House'.

cast.name: Raul Grijalva
cast.evidence: A chyron at the end of the video states, 'she replaces her father Raul Grijalva, who died in March.'

cast.name: U.S. Congress
cast.evidence: The event takes place within the U.S. House of Representatives chamber, and the swearing-in is for a position in Congress.

on_screen_text.text: WATCH: Adelita Grijalva has been sworn in to Congress 💙

Honorable
Mike Johnson
Speaker of the House
Rep. Adelita Grijalva won a special election on Sept. 23 to represent AZ's 7th district; she replaces her father Raul Grijalva, who died in March.

spoken_summary: Speaker of the House Mike Johnson calls Representative-elect Adelita Grijalva and the Arizona delegation to the well of the House. He then administers the oath of office, asking if she will support and defend the Constitution of the United States. Grijalva responds, "I do." Johnson then says, "Congratulations. You're now a member of the 119th Congress," followed by applause from the chamber.
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of spoken dialogue from the floor of the House of Representatives, followed by the sound of loud, sustained applause.
editing_pacing: The video is edited in a standard broadcast style, showing wide shots of the chamber and closer shots of the Speaker. It includes a split-screen effect to show both the Speaker and the Representative-elect simultaneously during the oath.
central_claim: Adelita Grijalva has been officially sworn in as a member of the U.S. Congress.
intended_effect: To inform viewers about Adelita Grijalva joining Congress and to generate a sense of pride and celebration around the event.
